organizationDomain.primarySemantics: isPrimary flag controls platform sitemap exclusion and 308 redirects
organizationDomain.wwwHandling: www prefix stripped by normalizeDomainHost; single domain row sufficient
organizationDomain.tenantIsolation: ACTIVE status + active organization + not deleted

organizationEndpoint.publicMapping: OrganizationDomain reference with empty pathPrefix for storefront root
organizationEndpoint.appMapping: Optional; required for branded PWA manifest on custom domain

routing.platformRedirect: Platform indexable shop paths 308 redirect to custom domain when isPrimary

seo.canonicalBehavior: Custom domain becomes primary canonical when isPrimary
seo.sitemap: Tenant sitemap at /sitemap.xml on custom domain; excluded from platform sitemap when primary domain exists
seo.localeRepresentation: Default locale (fa) strips locale prefix from public paths

pwa.gap: PUBLIC-only custom domains receive platform manifest, not tenant-branded manifest

auth.notes: Auth.js callbacks rewritten to custom origin; sessions are host-only; no cross-origin SSO

commerce.cart: PASS - uses buildOrganizationPublicPath which is custom-domain aware
commerce.checkout: PASS - rewritten internally with tenant context headers
commerce.payment: FLAG - callback domain isolation not explicitly audited; recommend stable platform or APP origin
commerce.hardcodedBazarbaazAssumptions: None found in cart/checkout/order URL construction

callback.currentImplementation: Auth.js callbacks rewritten to custom origin for user-facing flows; provider callbacks not explicitly isolated

infrastructure.dnsSteps: A record to 76.76.21.21 or CNAME to cname.vercel-dns.com

customDomainOnboarding.failures: Pre-existing branding-field fixture mismatches (logoInverse, mark, maskable icons, themeColor, backgroundColor)

minorGaps.description: PUBLIC-only custom domains receive platform manifest instead of tenant-branded manifest
minorGaps.suggestedMilestone: Minor extension to manifest resolver to support PUBLIC domain branding
